description: Eclipse Zephyr — the Bluesky adapter: the family's open-protocol reference implementation, using the AT Protocol's sanctioned records and services while keeping CETech's review-first and engagement limits fully in force. v0.1 is a PUBLIC-READ adapter: profile_read, actor_search, author_feed_read, and post_thread_read call the AT Protocol public API (public.api.bsky.app, no auth), normalize results with per-item source endpoints, and receipt every read — failures included — into a hash-chained ledger. Live reads were smoke-verified from this VM on 2026-10-25 (profile, author feed, and search for @bsky.app returned live data). Rate discipline is encoded: minimum call interval, per-process call budget, bounded retries on transient failures only, gzip + Connection: close transport (this VM's egress proxy truncates large chunked keep-alive bodies). Analytics honesty per spec SS6/SS17: no native view metric is invented; custom feeds change what 'the feed' means, so figures carry their source endpoint. There is deliberately NO posting, following, liking, or repost surface in v0.1 — posting requires an owner account plus an approved hash-bound pack (Wave 2), and protocol possibility is not product permission.
